hints.title: Use Standard Reflected Gray Code
hints.text: The standard n-bit Gray code formula is i ^ (i >> 1) for index i from 0 to 2^n - 1.

hints.title: Preserve Single Bit Adjacent Changes
hints.text: XORing every element in a cyclic Gray code sequence with any constant start preserves 1-bit adjacent differences.

hints.title: Start at Given Value Directly
hints.text: Construct the array with start bitwise xor (i bitwise xor (i >> 1)), which starts at start for i = 0.

hints.title: See the blueprint

complexity.whyNaiveFails: Graph searching for Hamiltonian cycles takes exponential backtracking time.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Gray code formula generates the sequence directly in optimal O(2^N) time with no extra memory.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate should recognize Gray code structure and XOR shift property.
complexity.notes: start is guaranteed to be less than 2^n.
